relationships.subject: sodium hypochlorite
relationships.evidence_quote: NaOCl lavage did not only increase the survival of affected pulps substantially but also particularly diminished painful failures (33% in the NaOCl group vs 62% in the saline group).

relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: High MMP-9/total protein values in pulpal fluid collected from the exposed site indicated early and painful treatment failures

key_findings: NaOCl lavage improved 4-year pulp survival and reduced painful failures after direct pulp capping.
High pulpal MMP-9 predicted early painful failures only.
